channel.title: Blog | Abdelwahab Mahmoud
channel.description: Case studies and notes from building production systems.

item.title: Handling backpressure in Node.js streams
item.description: A Node.js stream says slow down with one boolean. Ignore it and a single stalled client parks 200 MiB in your process. Here is how the signal travels.

item.title: Building a booking marketplace from empty repo to beta
item.description: A booking marketplace from empty repo to beta: a deploy gate in week one, and a Postgres exclusion constraint that rejects double bookings.

item.title: Preventing stock overselling in Redis with Lua scripts
item.description: Every Redis command is atomic. The check-then-write your app wraps around them is not, and that gap is how 100 units become 121 orders.

item.title: Live order status over Socket.IO and Redis
item.description: Socket.IO delivers at most once by default, so live order status on a driver's phone is only as good as the Redis read it makes on reconnect.

item.title: Extracting fulfillment from a PHP monolith over SQS
item.description: Fulfillment came out of a PHP monolith piece by piece, over the SQS queue it already had. FIFO only dedupes sends, so the consumer still has to be idempotent.

item.title: Fixing 100% CPU on Aurora MySQL by removing a join
item.description: A status broadcast made about a thousand queries, each estimated at 7 million rows, and pinned Aurora at 100% CPU. The fix was a dropped join, not an index.

item.title: Making LLM triage verdicts testable in code
item.description: Prompting an LLM to be careful never made pass/fail testable. Moving the verdict into code did, and replaying old incidents caught three false passes.

item.title: Handling LLM rate limits as reschedules, not errors
item.description: Rate limits caused 65% of our LLM review failures. Treating them as reschedules, not errors, kept provider throttling from becoming our outage.

item.title: Scaling ECS workers on queue depth without killing long jobs
item.description: ECS scale-in was killing translation jobs up to two hours into their run. Scaling on queue depth and letting busy tasks finish before they stop fixed it.
